description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class for generating Playwright test scripts in JavaScript, including methods for creating test headers, footers, and action code snippets, with support for different execution contexts and options.

classes.name: JavaScriptLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JavaScript code for Playwright actions, supporting test and standalone modes.

classes.name: JavaScriptFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting JavaScript code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for a specific user action within a test or script.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates the code snippet for executing a specific action, such as click, fill, navigate, or assertions.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the header part of the script, either for a test or standalone script.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer part of the script, closing contexts and browser instances.

methods.name: generateTestHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a Playwright test, including imports and test setup.

methods.name: generateTestFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a Playwright test.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Creates the header for a standalone Playwright script.

methods.name: generateStandaloneFooter
methods.description: Creates the footer for a standalone Playwright script.
